title: Strength and Lean muscle building ideal for Teens
author: John C.
desc: To gain lean muscle mass and work towards achieving your dream physique while having fun too by hitting new PR’s almost every week, noticing yourself get stronger each time and building the discipline you need for the rest of your life.

ex.note: You want a close grip, but not too close; you should be able to fit 2 of your fists in between your grip

This will blast your upper chest, set the incline machine at about a 40 degree slant, but make sure to remember what it’s at so you’ll do the same thing every time. 
Use a wide grip on this one
Push out your chest when doing this, and focus on converging. Keep your arms locked and don’t ego lift. Also adjust the seat so that your actually hitting your chest
It’s ok to swing just slightly, but don’t rely on it. Still focus on your bicep and train hard if not to failure.
Make sure not to curl outwards and if you are, then lean forward more, hollow out your chest and put your elbow closer to your nee cap. Then try again
Do a close stance squat, this will make your legs huge (the close stance squat will hit your outer quads).
If you have a hack squat machine then great, but if you don’t it’s also fine; you can use the smith machine. Just choose a wider stance (this will hit your inner quad).
If you have straps at your gym then definitely use them. Find a open path and step down. Don’t take a long step (that will hit your glutes) take a nice small step so that your quads grow.
Make sure your forms good for these, look up some good videos online and listen to them.

Don’t skip out on calves, if you want big legs, you still have to hit calves!
When doing these, hold and squeeze at the top then slow down. Take little to no rest at the bottom before going back up

I call these weighted prayers, they’re probably my favourite ab exercise.
Watch a video for good form though 
(Not this one) 🤫
For these next 3 exercises do 1 set or bicycles, then instantly after do your leg raises, then straight to Russian twists and finish off with a plank, rest for 1 minute then repeat 3x.
Put your hands on the back of your head, that will engage your core really well.
If you can do more than a minute, then add more time, but if you can’t do a minute then go to absolute failure, so that the next time it will be easier
Choose a medium hand grip, lean back slightly and pull to your chest, then stretch all the way up feeling your lat stretch
Make sure not to who lift on this exercise, pull and touch your chest then stretch your oat at the bottom
Make sure your postures good, look straight ahead, pull and squeeze your oat as hard as you can. Then stretch your arms out as far as you can possibly go (building your lat) with good posture.
Twist the bench so that it’s parallel to the mirror to check your form. Make sure your back is level (you can bend your nee to help with that) and stretch as far as you can go, then squeeze hard
Keep your arms locked, and push fast/controlled down then slow up.
Sit down on a back assisted seat, then perform the exercise
Keep good posture during each set
You can use an EZ bar for this one, make sure your reaching high up
Don’t do lateral raises like the guy in the video, look up actual good form, because these are truly amazing, do not ego lift though
Training neck might seem weird, but there’s actually tons of health benefits as well as look benefits by training it
You’re not going to look weird doing these, nobody’s going to laugh at you except maybe your skinny friends who are never gonna look good, cause they’re not committed, not disciplined.
